mapper.insert: INSERT INTO electronic_approval ( title, doc_type, approval_status, draft_dt, drafter_id, drafter_name, department_name ) VALUES ( #{title}, #{docType}, #{approvalStatus}, #{draftDate}, #{drafterId}, #{drafterName}, #{departmentName} )
mapper.update: UPDATE electronic_approval SET approval_status = 'COMPLETE', approve_dt = NOW() WHERE approval_id = #{approvalId}

choose.when: ea.approval_status = 'COMPLETE' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM recipient_line rli WHERE rli.approval_id = ea.approval_id AND rli.receiver_id = #{employeeId} )

mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM electronic_approval ea WHERE

SELECT ea.approval_id AS approvalId, ea.doc_id AS docId, ea.doc_type AS docType, ea.title AS title, ea.approval_status AS approvalStatus, ea.draft_dt AS draftDate, ea.approve_dt AS approveDate, ea.drafter_id AS drafterId, ea.drafter_name AS drafterName, ea.department_name AS departmentName, COALESCE( ( SELECT al.read_dt FROM approval_line al WHERE al.approval_id = ea.approval_id AND al.approver_id = #{employeeId} ORDER BY al.approval_seq ASC LIMIT 1 ), ( SELECT rf.read_dt FROM reference_line rf WHERE rf.approval_id = ea.approval_id AND rf.referencer_id = #{employeeId} ORDER BY rf.reference_id ASC LIMIT 1 ), ( SELECT rc.read_dt FROM recipient_line rc WHERE rc.approval_id = ea.approval_id AND rc.receiver_id = #{employeeId} ORDER BY rc.recipient_id ASC LIMIT 1 ) ) AS readDate FROM electronic_approval ea WHERE
ORDER BY ea.draft_dt DESC, ea.approval_id DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT approval_id AS approvalId, doc_type AS docType, doc_id AS docId, title AS title, approval_status AS approvalStatus, draft_dt AS draftDate, drafter_id AS drafterId, drafter_name AS drafterName, department_name AS departmentName, approve_dt AS approveDate FROM electronic_approval WHERE approval_id = #{approvalId}
